entries.text: Good morning, packaging department. Ravi speaking.
entries.easy_read:
The phone rings.
I say hello.
I say my team and my name.

entries.text: May I know who is calling, please?
entries.easy_read:
I do not know this person.
I ask their name.

entries.text: Could you hold for a moment, please?
entries.easy_read:
Please wait a little.
I will come back.

entries.text: I will put you through to my supervisor.
entries.easy_read:
I will pass the phone.
My boss will talk to you.

entries.text: Sorry, the line is not clear. Could you say that again?
entries.easy_read:
The phone sound is bad.
Please say it again.

entries.text: She is not at her desk. May I take a message?
entries.easy_read:
She is not here now.
I can write your words.

entries.text: Could you repeat the number slowly, please?
entries.easy_read:
I want to write the number.
Please say it slowly.

entries.text: May I call you back in ten minutes?
entries.easy_read:
I am busy now.
I will phone you later.

entries.text: I find it easier on message. Could you send me the details?
entries.easy_read:
Phone calls are hard for me.
Please send a message.

The talk is done.
I say thank you and goodbye.

entries.text: I think you have the wrong number.
entries.easy_read:
This is not the right person.
I tell them kindly.

entries.text: Good morning. This is Ravi. I am unwell and cannot come in today.
entries.easy_read:
I phone my boss.
I say my name.
I say I am not well.

entries.text: Am I speaking to the stores department?
entries.easy_read:
I want the right team.
I ask if this is them.

entries.text: This is Ravi from packaging. Please call me back when you can.
entries.easy_read:
Nobody answers.
I say my name and my team.
I ask them to phone me.
